HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW: CHAMPAGNES (10) is a smart trotting mare that keeps rising to the occasion over the last 12 months. She keeps on winning and going up in class, but also keeps stepping up. When she trots fluently, she’s hard to beat. She loves to be in front, which is unlikely here from barrier ten, but she has the class. IM EDDIE (1) is racing well and has enough gate speed to map positively here. He looks well placed if he trots well. MET WITH A SHRUG (2) has been a bit hit or miss with her manners recently. She has ability and, if she is on her best behaviour, she’s right in this. SOSO MAJESTIC (9) is a talented trotter at his best, and he’s having his sixth start back since having two years on the sidelines. He would be reaching peak fitness now. Barrier nine is suitable. BACK: CHAMPAGNES (10) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:CHAMPAGNES (10), IM EDDIE (1), MET WITH A SHRUG (2), SOSO MAJESTIC (9)

OVERVIEW: DREAMS OF LOVE (3) is an interesting trotter. As a young horse, she raced the best horses of her age group, including horses like Keayang Zahara. Since then, she has had a few different trainers and travelled interstate and probably hasn’t found her best. She now lands in the care of Kaylene Ward and is having her third start in her stable. She hit the line really nicely for third last start at Melton and will be fitter now third up. NO TELLING HEATHER (6) is a fast mare who often finds the fence early in her races. She’s a threat if she gets a good run, but the barrier does look like a challenge for her here with some fast beginners to her inside. BLACKRANGE GLORY (11) is a talented trotter, but he has his quirks. He wasn’t at his best last start, tiring late, but he was first up, so he can be excused for that. Generally, he can get it wrong with his manners, but at his best, he is very smart. Trainers request to remain ODM here as it helps him settle. WALKIN UNDERSTARZ (5) is racing well and, with luck and a good race map, is a first four chance here. BACK: DREAMS OF LOVE (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:DREAMS OF LOVE (3), NO TELLING HEATHER (6), BLACKRANGE GLORY (11), WALKIN UNDERSTARZ (5)

OVERVIEW: SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (9) had his first career start on August 21 after some impressive trials. In his first start, he nearly ran down the smart FANTASY FLIGHT and was only narrowly beaten. He has ability and will improve from his first start. Barrier nine suits. BETTOR TORQUE (7) has had one career start, finishing fourth at Ararat. He looked like he was still figuring out what racing was all about but really let down nicely over the last 200m. He has a tricky barrier but seems to have ability. QUEENS BOULEVARD (2) will likely start from barrier one if the emergency does not gain a start. She was eye-catching when fourth on debut. She did it tough at Charlton and will improve on that performance. MAJOR FRIEND (3) is a well-bred filly that has placed in five of her seven career starts. She is racing well and is close to breaking through with her maiden win. Also respecting HEZ NOTTHE MESSIAH (8) and KAIDENBOY (10) if they get some luck from their barriers here. BACK: SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (9), BETTOR TORQUE (7), QUEENS BOULEVARD (2), MAJOR FRIEND (3)

OVERVIEW: This maiden trot looks to have a few chances. DELTA GEE (3) is having her second career start. On debut, she finished second after getting well back but running home well into second. In the run, she beat MI BOW (4) right on the line. MI BOW (4) is an interesting trotter. She rarely puts in a bad run, but she is a 33-start maiden. She usually just can’t find that win, but she always runs well. WHY NOW (1) has had two career runs. Last start, she got checked late when making a wide run, so that performance can be ruled out. On debut, she let down nicely for second. If she trots well, she is right in this. ALECTRONA (5) has let down nicely in her last two runs. If she gets a good trip, she will likely be flashing home again. Also respecting LEZAMA (8) here. BACK: DELTA GEE (3)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:DELTA GEE (3), MI BOW (4), WHY NOW (1), ALECTRONA (5)

OVERVIEW: DRESSEDUPINTHECITY (2) is looking to break through with her maiden victory at start 48 in this NR up to 38 event. Although she was beaten by 19 metres last start, she did seem to hit the line well. She can map well from barrier two. CHARLIE WALKER (6) is second up here and will improve on his first-up eighth at Maryborough. He may opt to use his gate speed here. NUCLEAR ATTITUDE (8) is racing well and always seems to put his best hoof forward on this track. He’s the only horse on the back line here, so he has options. BETSY ANNE (4) has the best sectional times in this event and flashed home very well into second last start. SELECTIONS:DRESSEDUPINTHECITY (2), CHARLIE WALKER (6), NUCLEAR ATTITUDE (8), BETSY ANNE (4)

OVERVIEW: This race looks to have many winning chances. MIKISPUR (5) has the best sectional times in this event, although his numerical form doesn’t look fantastic. If he maps well with luck, he is a good chance. JUST PEDRO (1) has got it wrong with his manners in his last two starts. However, he is good enough to win this event if he brings his best and can map well from his barrier. MAJOR ROY (6) is a lightly raced horse having his sixth start here, although he is first up. He won his last start well before going for a spell. The barrier looks awkward, however, for a horse who is first up. ARTIST (3) is an interesting runner having his second start for trainer Basil Dooley. He did get tired in his first-up run, but he’s had a month between runs now and likely will have found improvement. At his best, he’s a winning chance. SELECTIONS: MIKISPUR (5), JUST PEDRO (1), MAJOR ROY (6), ARTIST (3)

OVERVIEW: This looks to be another even contest. IMALLATTITUDE (2) is a horse who suits barrier two. He doesn’t have good gate speed, so he’s unlikely to find the front. However, barrier two suits as he stays in the running line without having to give up too much ground early. He is racing consistently well and looks well suited here. BETA THAN LOVE (1) was first up back in Victoria for trainer Samantha Gangell last start and was massively improved after a below-best QLD campaign. He’s likely to improve again and barrier one suits. KIMCHI (5) has to overcome an awkward barrier here but is racing okay and has a nice turn of foot. JUST LIKE NUGGET (4) is a horse who, although he’s only won one race, rarely puts in a poor performance. He has a great turn of foot and is well prepared by trainer Kate Hargreaves. BLUE MIKI (7) is also not far away from getting back into the winner’s circle but has a sticky barrier. SELECTIONS:IMALLATTITUDE (2), BETA THAN LOVE (1),KIMCHI (5), JUST LIKE NUGGET (4)

OVERVIEW: BETTORSWEETVICTORY (2) is a competitive mare that rarely puts in a bad run. She should be able to map well from barrier two. ROLLING REMONA (8) is having her second start for the team here. She was last first up after pulling in the run, but it was in a tougher grade. She drops down in grade here, will improve from the run and has options from barrier eight. MARGARITARI (5) was okay last start, racing in the breeze for the final lap at Charlton and wasn’t beaten too far into fourth. She will need luck here, but she races well at her best. LIKE A GAZELLE (4) is third up here and will be reaching peak fitness. She broke through with her maiden victory at this track at the end of last campaign. She looks a winning chance here with the right run. MYDEEPESTDESIRE (6) is an interesting runner to note here. She is a well-bred first starter with solid trial form. BACK: BETTORSWEETVICTORY (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:BETTORSWEETVICTORY (2), ROLLING REMONA (8), MARGARITARI (5), LIKE A GAZELLE (4)

OVERVIEW: OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (3) is a nice mare trained and driven by champion reinswoman Kerryn Manning. She is capable of showing gate speed and may try to get forward here. My only concern is she may not be finishing off her races recently as well as she can at her best, but she is a smart mare. KISS ME MINI (2) flashed home late well last start to only narrowly get beaten by KEAYANG PAYTON. She has ability and a great turn of foot. CELESTIAL ZODIAC (6) was an eye-catching second last start. He’s an experienced horse who is racing well but has a tricky barrier to overcome. HAPPILY (1) looks to be a promising, progressive filly. She’s only had seven starts for two wins. She’s likely to have improved with experience this time in. Barrier one is ideal, but fitness is a query. SHAZZA LOVE (5) and TOPSIES BLING (4) I also respect here. SELECTIONS: OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (3),KISS ME MINI (2), CELESTIAL ZODIAC (6), HAPPILY (1) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: ESPERANZA (9) has been racing well recently. Last start, she didn’t have the most clear running late but seemed to run on okay. Her run prior was strong when racing in the breeze. She looks well placed here from barrier nine. VERY TEMPTING (10) has been racing okay and rarely puts in a bad run when he gets luck in running. If he can have a positive trip here, he could be the horse flashing home late. ATOMIC GLORY (2) should be able to map positively here from barrier two with his gate speed. BLUE OCEAN (5) has been racing consistently but will need to overcome his barrier. BACK: ESPERANZA (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ESPERANZA (9), VERY TEMPTING (10), ATOMIC GLORY (2), BLUE OCEAN (5)

OVERVIEW: CITY ROCKSTAR (4) had a tough, unlucky run last start in harder grade. Her start prior was a good second when travelling with cover. She seems best when driven with one run. If she can map well, she finds a race to get back in the winner’s circle. OWEN THE SAINTS (9) is a better horse than what his recent form looks like on paper. He’s had bad luck and also a few incidents where he hasn’t got his manners right. However, barrier nine will allow him to settle early and stay out of trouble. ASSIGNED (3) has the best overall sectional times in this event. He also drops in class, getting into the event with a claim drive for Nick Beale. OZZIE SUNSHINE (1) can take advantage of the ace barrier here to try to find some of his old strong form. Also respecting BLAZIN BY (8), who returned a winner last start at this track and will likely improve again, and MAURLEN COMPASS (7), who has a sticky barrier but, on times, is the fastest swooper in this event. FEEL THE REIGN (2) could also find some good form from the positive barrier. SELECTIONS:CITY ROCKSTAR (4), OWEN THE SAINTS (9), ASSIGNED (3),OZZIE SUNSHINE (1)

OVERVIEW: ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (6) is in great form, winning two of her last four, both wins coming from Melton. She has to overcome a poor barrier, but she has the confidence and best sectional times in this race. GOODTIME MAE (2) has been out of the winner’s circle for some time. However, she does have enough gate speed to find the fence here and will be in a positive race position to give her every chance. FAVOURITEHIGHLIGHT (5) is an experienced mare looking for win 29. She’s in consistent good form. She can be versatile. THE IRISHMAN (9) is a horse that can make his own luck. He was in the breeze two starts ago and was too strong. He’s racing well. SELECTIONS: ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (6), GOODTIME MAE (2), FAVOURITEHIGHLIGHT (5), THE IRISHMAN (9)

OVERVIEW: FLYIN TIME (3) has been racing well. Last start, she was third when utilising the sprint lane. But it was her run three starts back when first up that caught my eye. She was wide and storming home well. She looks ready to get back into the winner’s circle. KALARNEY PRINCE (1) has gate speed and the best sectional times in this event. Barrier one suits. The horse on its back, ALDEBARAN DENBAY (8), has a good turn of foot and will be ready to flash home late. JUST ME AND YOU (4) has been racing well but needs to overcome a sticky barrier. BACK: FLYIN TIME (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: FLYIN TIME (3), KALARNEY PRINCE (1), ALDEBARAN DENBAY (8), JUST ME AND YOU (4)

OVERVIEW: THEROUX (3) is a progressive horse who seems to get a bit better each preparation. He is third up here and should be race fit. His two runs back have been okay and he looks well placed here. DIVINE TILLY (5) is a mare with a great turn of foot when she is at her best. She had to do it tough last start in the breeze and will probably be looking for cover here. With a good trip, she will likely figure late. FOREGONE CONCLUSION (6) is in fantastic form, winning four of his last six starts. He seems to race very well in these concession driver races. He can run well again here. WOW YOU CAN DANCE (4) has been a bit up and down with his form this season, but if he can show his best, he’s a first four chance here. BACK: THEROUX (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:THEROUX (3), DIVINE TILLY (5), FOREGONE CONCLUSION (6),

OVERVIEW: SCAR (5) is also in great form. He always puts in a good run when he trots throughout. If he can overcome the sticky barrier, he can win again. FREMARKS PEGGY (2) is in career-best form, winning seven races this season and placing in 10 others. She has an ideal barrier here to use to her advantage. QUEEN KIZEN (6) is returning from a short South Australian campaign. She finished second earlier this year in the Warragul Trotters Cup. She has ability and a great turn of foot. I can’t leave out this sister to champion mare Queen Elida. CHARLESTON AVENUE (8) is first up here and is the only horse on the back row, so he has race map options. He is a quality horse that can be versatile. Fitness is the query. CHAMPAGNE GEMMA (4) is in terrific form, winning her last three races, including two at Melton. She has the confidence. SELECTIONS: SCAR (5), FREMARKS PEGGY (2), QUEEN KIZEN (6), CHARLESTON AVENUE (8)

OVERVIEW: ARCHAA (7)’s run last start can be forgotten. He found the front but was checked and galloped. His prior seven runs were fantastic, finishing in the top three and winning four. My only concern here is he usually likes to find the front, but there is gate speed drawn to his inside here. BRONSKI ROYAL (1) looks to have had a few setbacks, only having had six starts since 2024. He’s third up this time in and should be fitter now. Barrier one gives him the opportunity to regain some form. MIDNIGHT MOJO (6) has the best recent sectional times in this event and, from the barrier, will likely be saved for one run. SMOKING SHANNON (5) has shown mixed form in her two starts for Jamie Egan. First up, she led and won, and in her second run, she led but tired late. She does have good gate speed here and potentially could be first to the fence. An interesting runner to note in this event is FOUR EVER A STAR (3). She has not raced since November 2023 and is first up for trainer Rita Burnett. BACK: ARCHAA (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ARCHAA (7), BRONSKI ROYAL (1), MIDNIGHT MOJO (6), SMOKING SHANNON (5)

OVERVIEW: LE GASTON (6) is a smart colt for trainer Jess Tubbs. He has been unlucky in a few runs and is ready to win his maiden. He is first up since February but has had a few trials. His class is likely to prevail. DONTTELLNANNA (7) raced fiercely last start and broke. This run can be forgotten. She does have some ability, but she is green. If she’s on her best behaviour, she could perform well here. DEMARTINO (2) is a very well-bred filly, closely related to Lazarus, having her third career start. She will likely be looking for cover here after tiring after racing in the breeze last start. She could be an improver. CAPTAIN MILO (1) has shown some promise, but he can get it wrong with his manners. If he settles here and gets a good trip, he could be flashing home late. Also noting LIKE A LIBRARIAN (5), who is having her second start and is first up in Victoria for new trainer Andrew German. BACK: LE GASTON (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:LE GASTON (6), DONTTELLNANNA (7), DEMARTINO (2), CAPTAIN MILO (1),

OVERVIEW: LITTLE MISS VALLEY (1) is a very smart mare who looks to have a bright future. She is first up here since July, but she should be able to map well here. SAM NIEN (2) is a proven feature race winner from when he was younger. He has fantastic gate speed, which he will likely utilise here to get forward. He may just be racing a little below his best. BROTHER MOUNTAIN (4) is a smart gelding coming out of the Group 3 The Holmfield. He is a versatile trotter and, from his barrier, will likely make his own luck here. AVANT GUARD (5) is a genuine trotter that has raced in fields stronger than this many times. He may not be right at his best, but he is still likely to put forward a strong run. He stands out being a flashy chestnut with a blaze. SELECTIONS:LITTLE MISS VALLEY (1), SAM NIEN (2) BROTHER MOUNTAIN (4), AVANT GUARD (5),

OVERVIEW: ROYAL LADY (5) is a first starter for Brent Lilley who was bred in New Zealand. She has had some nice trials in the lead-up to her debut here. She looks promising. Noting she is a two-year-old filly up against older horses, which may be challenging. QUEEN OFTHE SUMMIT (6) is a very well-bred filly who had one start in July, where she let down nicely at Cranbourne. BIG RAIN (2) is one of the more experienced trotters in this field. She is consistent and rarely, if ever, puts a hoof wrong. GLOBAL ELITE (4) is another first starter in this event and one to watch. SELECTIONS: ROYAL LADY (5), QUEEN OFTHE SUMMIT (6), BIG RAIN (2), GLOBAL ELITE (4) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:DREAMTIME NALA (5) possesses early speed and has been performing fairly well in the South-East. She led throughout to defeat Mynameisruby at a Melton victory on July 15, which is a good form pointer for this event. BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (7) performed below expectations when last of ten at Mildura last week. His form in South Australia prior was sound and he strikes a very suitable assignment now so he is worth another chance. FLEUR BELLA (6) is a former New South Wales pacer, which settled in a rearward position and ran into a distant third at Mildura last week. She is poorly drawn again but has the ability to figure in the finish. ROCKING WROXTON (2) and EGBERT (3) both possess early speed and should be prominent throughout from their good draw. SELECTIONS: DREAMTIME NALA (5), BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (7), FLEUR BELLA (6), ROCKING WROXTON (2)

OVERVIEW:ACCELERE (4) has performed well in two local starts since returning from Queensland and is ready to break through for a win. He worked forward to find the front from an extreme draw and fought on strongly for second behind OUR MASTER PLAY (1) last outing. OUR MASTER PLAY (1) has won two of his past three starts and defeated a field of similar quality last week. He is perfectly drawn so he is worth thought again. RED HOT MIKI (7) didn’t have a great deal of luck when seventh at Mildura last week and broke stride at the start at his previous attempt. He is better than his form reads and strikes a suitable assignment so an improved showing is expected. ALWAYS ON SAFARI (6) will appreciate a significant drop back in class for this assignment and is not without a chance. BACK: ACCELERE (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ACCELERE (4), OUR MASTER PLAY (1), RED HOT MIKI (7), ALWAYS ON SAFARI (6)

OVERVIEW: CAPTIVATE ME (4) has been placed in four of his five starts at Mildura and deserves to break through for a win. He has attempted to lead throughout at his past two seconds behind the handy types in You’ve Been Served and Seaside Lady. BETTER THEN DAICOS (5) attempted to lead throughout when second behind Notguilty at Mildura last week. He finished in fourth behind Fantasy Flight at Melton prior and should be very competitive under these conditions. SWEET LUCY LOU (8) settled midfield on the markers, was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off well when third at Mildura last outing. She hasn’t had much luck recently and is worth a ticket each way. CRUEL MISTRESS (6) was placed three starts in succession prior to a fifth last week, where she had to work hard on the outside of the leader. She has a tough draw to overcome but is racing well enough to figure in the finish. SELECTIONS: CAPTIVATE ME (4), BETTER THEN DAICOS (5), SWEET LUCY LOU (8), CRUEL MISTRESS (6)

OVERVIEW: MAJOR LINCOLN (4) and KEAYANG CRIPPA (7) have notched up one win a piece in their rivalry over the past two weeks and luck in running might be the key to the result today. MAJOR LINCOLN (4) has the best barrier draw and he did come from a rearward position when a fast finishing second last week so he gets the nod. KEAYANG CRIPPA (7) raced without cover throughout in both of his performances over the last fortnight and did very well each time. He is drawn on the inside of the second line now, which is a disadvantage. SNEAKY PHILTRA (1) will appreciate her best draw for some time and has won three races at Mildura recently. She settled last on the markers and moved through the middle in the back straight when fifth behind Our Master Play last week. HESASTAR (6) continues to perform well against similar opposition and is very versatile. He was headed off at the start and moved up without cover at the 700m mark when a handy third last week. SELECTIONS: MAJOR LINCOLN (4), KEAYANG CRIPPA (7), SNEAKY PHILTRA (1), HESASTAR (6)

OVERVIEW:ROYAL ROCKSTAR (4) was caught wide early, progressed forward to race without cover and battled on well for a close third behind Starvin Marvin last week. He led throughout to defeat Seaside Lady (won since) at Ballarat three starts ago and looms as one of the leading chances again. LISTEN TO THE HAND (3) broke stride at the 800m and did well to finish as close as he did when sixth (10m) behind CELESTIAL NEBULAE (8) last week. He is a good chance of finding the lead and will take catching. CELESTIAL NEBULAE (8) produced a strong finishing burst when a big winner over My Ultimate Henry last week. His past two wins have been impressive and he is one of the leading chances again. RONZEL RAFA (6) hasn’t had much luck over the past few weeks and is worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: ROYAL ROCKSTAR (4) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: ROYAL ROCKSTAR (4), LISTEN TO THE HAND (3), CELESTIAL NEBULAE (8), RONZEL RAFA (6)

OVERVIEW:PRIORITISE (7) is resuming since a close third behind All Da Rage at Mildura on July 03. He was a brilliant winner over the smart pacer My Ultimate Jimmy in fast time prior and should prove hard to beat if he gains the right luck from his awkward draw. DHAULAGIRI (2) was resuming since May when he performed below expectations at Globe Derby, where he parked without cover and tired late. He did very well at Country Cups level last season and he will make his presence felt if he is somewhere near his peak. NEW YORKER (1) is perfectly drawn for his Mildura debut and he was competing at Metropolitan level during his last preparation. He was never extended at any stage when fifth at a recent Shepparton trial performance and is worth an investment. DON LOU (3) appeared to have every hope when fifth last outing but he produced a big finish to win first up so he is worth another chance. SELECTIONS: PRIORITISE (7), DHAULAGIRI (2), NEW YORKER (1), DON LOU (3)

OVERVIEW: WATCH THE ATTITUDE (9) is a tough type and will appreciate a big drop back in class on her past two performances. She led throughout and scored by a very large margin in a mile rate of 1.56.5 on August 07 so she should prove hard to beat against this line up. VINNY ROCK (5) commenced from the outside of the second line, settled down in last position and made ground late without threatening at his latest seventh. He will appreciate moving to the front line and his form prior was sound so he is worth another chance. CAULONIA TERROR (1) was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off solidly for third behind Just Incredible then followed with an unplaced effort last week. He is perfectly drawn to gain an economical run on the markers and rates as a value hope. SHES POPPY (4) and RUBBLEONTHEDOUBLE (6) both are worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: WATCH THE ATTITUDE (9) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: WATCH THE ATTITUDE (9), VINNY ROCK (5), CAULONIA TERROR (1), RUBBLEONTHEDOUBLE (6)

OVERVIEW: GUEST ARTIST (1) is a fast beginner and should be in front for a long way from the pole position. He led throughout at a Mildura victory two weeks ago then had little luck when he had no clear run in the straight last week. KEAYANG MOROCCAN (8) ran home fairly well from midfield when third behind GUEST ARTIST (1) prior to a close up fifth last week, where he made ground from a rearward position. He is racing well and looms as one of the leading chances. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (9) had little room in the straight when a creditable fourth last week. She is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward and is worth a ticket each way. SPORTSBOU (3) was a winner at Mildura on June 26 and endured a tough run at her latest fifth. She should go well from the good draw. BACK: GUEST ARTIST (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: GUEST ARTIST (1), KEAYANG MOROCCAN (8), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (9), SPORTSBOU (3)

OVERVIEW: KYVALLEY DRIFTER (1) did plenty wrong on debut at Melton on August 21, but ultimately got the job done in good style with a strong victory over LOLLY (5). She hails from the powerful and in-form Chris Svanosio stable, draws well in gate one and should have taken plenty of benefit from that experience. There looks to be a motor there, and she’s happily on top in a race where manners will play a major role in the outcome. MISS MUSCLE (8) has a bit more experience on her side and draws to trail the leading selection. She hasn’t done much wrong at all in her four starts, which includes a good win in July. She was beaten last time out by MAJARO GIRL (9), but was forced to do a bit of work early there as a short-priced favourite and was only grabbed late. MAJARO GIRL (9) has shown gradual improvement since joining the Andy Gath barn and was a good winner last time out, while LOLLY (5) ran a ripper for second behind KYVALLEY DRIFTER (1) first-up from a spell and is a contender with the right trip. BACK: KYVALLEY DRIFTER (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: KYVALLEY DRIFTER (1), MISS MUSCLE (8), MAJARO GIRL (9), LOLLY (5)

OVERVIEW: Wide-open heat for the two-year-trotting fillies where plenty have claims. KYVALLEY DIXON (1) looks a decent play given her good gate and recent form, which includes back-to-back wins at Melton in July and Maryborough just last week. She should settle in front or on the leader’s back, and would likely be going close on her best behaviour. ZIPPIN PAST (2) is first-up from a break, has the gate speed to challenge for the top and showed good ability with three front-running triumphs in her first campaign, while BUMPER CROP (8) is an unbeaten talent from the Antti Ruokonen stable who heads here on the back of a nice trial and big success in the rich Nutrien final at Wagga in late May. She beat three rivals (all made breaks) there that reoppose here and is a great chance. ALDEBARAN EMJAY (4) looked set to challenge KYVALLEY DIXON (1) for victory first-up at Maryborough, but galloped in the concluding stages and was relegated to third. They look the key hopes, but not much would surprise. SELECTIONS: KYVALLEY DIXON (1), ZIPPIN PAST (2), BUMPER CROP (8), ALDEBARAN EMJAY (4)

OVERVIEW: HALLEBESOFINE (6) has been very impressive in all three runs this campaign and might ultimately find the top here with her gate speed. She led and was only beaten 6.6m in a strong Holmfield by star squaregaiter Pastor Dunbar on August 22, and before that led and won at Geelong. She has competed well in a number of big features across her career and looks hard to beat with the right trip. ADELAIDE RED (7) turned her form around in a big way when she charged to the front, handed up and sprint-laned to victory at Melton on August 21. She was a Group 1 winner as a two-year-old and brings plenty of class to this clash. IJUSTCANTSEEIT (9) did a power of work and dropped out as favourite in the Shepparton Trotters Oaks last time but was a huge Kilmore winner before that and has good ability, while PIPALICIOUS (8) looked set to challenge last time at Ballarat but was checked and broke after winning her maiden in dominant fashion at Maryborough. BACK: HALLEBESOFINE (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: HALLEBESOFINE (6), ADELAIDE RED (7), IJUSTCANTSEEIT (9), PIPALICIOUS (8)

OVERVIEW: GLADIATRIX (2) is a Group 1-winning trotter from New South Wales who heads back to Victoria looking to make amends for two disappointing results in the Vicbred and Breeders Crown finals as a two-year-old during 2025. She won the elite-level NSW Trotters Oaks in May and was a beaten short-priced favourite when caught parked last time out in the Group 2 Trot NSW Final in early July. She might be able to work to the top here, and from there would be hard to run down. ALDEBARAN ADA (1) is a classy trotter who won a heat and final of the rich Nutrien series at Wagga during May before being freshened for this assignment. From the good draw, she’s a key danger. QUEEN OF SEES (5) wasn’t beaten far in a recent trial at Melton and looks to have some good ability, while TRUSCOTTS ELEGANCE (8) charged late from the one-one to run down PURPLE MOON (7) and win in good style at Maryborough last week. They’re outside winning hopes, but certainly factors for trifecta and First 4 players along with the fast beginner ARGYLE MUSE (3). BACK: GLADIATRIX (2) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: GLADIATRIX (2), ALDEBARAN ADA (1), QUEEN OF SEES (5), TRUSCOTTS ELEGANCE (8)

OVERVIEW: JILLIBY AURA (2) was a Nutrien final winner as a two-year-old and presents here first-up from a third placing in the three-year-old decider of that series at Wagga in May. She was narrowly beaten as favourite in the Group 1 NSW Trotters Oaks before that and probably has the speed to find the front. She’s the one to beat. HARPERSEVEN (3) won the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series final last season at massive odds and ran a solid third first-up at Melton on August 21. She’s the other class runner of the field on exposed form. MAJESTIC YANKEE (7) and SO SKEPTICAL (9) ran first and second respectively in the Shepparton Trotters Oaks last time out, and while they might not have the ability of the top two selections, are certainly talented and can threaten with the right run. The first-up ZOOLU (5) looks the other key player as a three-time winner from 10 starts. SELECTIONS: JILLIBY AURA (2), HARPERSEVEN (3), SO SKEPTICAL (9), MAJESTIC YANKEE (7)

OVERVIEW: KEAYANG BAZLENKA (4) hails from the powerhouse trotting barn of Team Lee and started a $1.20 favourite in the Group 1 NSW Trotters Derby during May but ruined his chance with a break. He heads here first-up on the back of a trial win and he’s already a two-time elite-level victor, having beaten HOWDY MATE (1) in both the Breeders Crown and Vicbred Super Series finals as a two-year-old during 2025. HOWDY MATE (1) has a lovely draw, good fitness base and great winning chance. Two starts ago, he led and looked the winner into the straight but galloped late and allowed Unclad to run past him. Last time out, he was trapped five back the fence in a hot Holmfield and absolutely rattled late to finish fourth and just 7.3m behind Pastor Dunbar. A serious danger. THE PREACHER (2) was a great winner first-up in easier grade and then ran well when fifth in the Holmfield, SUPERIOR STRIDE (6) is a classy NSW visitor who competed in The Great Square in Queensland and did a good job to win at Menangle last time out when pressured in front, while TIMMY WHIZ (8) looks above average and the other key player from inside the back row. SELECTIONS: KEAYANG BAZLENKA (4), HOWDY MATE (1), THE PREACHER (2), TIMMY WHIZ (8)

OVERVIEW: PASTOR DUNBAR (1) is a star three-year who landed the Group 1 NSW Trotters Derby in May and returned from a break in brilliant style when he won the Holmfield at Melton on August 22. There, he sat parked and powered clear around the turn to beat a cracking field arrogantly. He’s fitter, draws gate one and is almost impossible to oppose. I’m a big fan of MISTER DEVEREAUX (2), who seems to be getting better and better this season. Last time out, he was nailed four back the pegs at Maryborough and savaged the line late to be beaten 2.2m in a slick last quarter. I’ve loved all his recent performances and he can run well at likely decent odds. UNCLAD (3) has returned a lovely three-year-old for Alison Alford and won two starts back at Melton before only a fair effort in the Holmfield, while IM HAVINTOTROT (7) was narrowly beaten first-up at Ballarat but did some work early and is a classy customer who has raced in features galore throughout the early part of his career. BACK: MISTER DEVEREAUX (2) – 3 units (place) SELECTIONS: PASTOR DUNBAR (1), MISTER DEVEREAUX (2), UNCLAD (3), IM HAVINTOTROT (7)

OVERVIEW: MUNNY THE MUNSTER (3) was right in the market first-up from a break when just a fair seventh in the Holmfield, but his run before a spell in late May was a dominant victory in the rich Nutrien series final at Wagga. He ran a narrow second in the Group 1 NSW Trotters Derby last campaign as well, and presents here in heat three as the horse to beat. PASS THE SALT (9) was a really tough winner from the chair first-up at Kilmore and was perhaps a little plain after that but has trialled well since, ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (10) is a nice trotter for veteran horseman Ray Cross and won well at Maryborough two back before being outclassed in the Holmfield latest, while the consistent REVERAND BOB (7), last-start winner and NSW raider I CHOOSE YOU (5), SA visitor IDEOLOGY (1) and dominant maiden victor JET PLANE (2) are some others that could figure with the right trip. SELECTIONS: MUNNY THE MUNSTER (3), PASS THE SALT (9), ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (10), REVERAND BOB (7)

OVERVIEW: VERBICI (5) is a star two-year-old trotter who is undefeated from five career starts and heads here as one of the horses to beat in the series. He had a freshen after his victory in the Group 2 NSW Trot Final in early July and returned in glamourous style with a dashing win from the one-one at Melton on August 22. He was driven confidently by Chris Lang and speared past leader REGAL GALA (7) with a slick last half and quarter to win. He’s very good. KYVALLEY DIABLO (1) was trapped parked in that race and dropped out late but had trialled well behind VERBICI (5) before that, won incredibly well on debut in June and draws well here, REGAL GALA (7) has really improved with experience and probably has the gate speed to lead this contest, while KEAYANG MARCUS (3) won on debut at Terang on July 12 when leading, beating home subsequent winner Miss Muscle. He’s a factor, along with the returning THE WOOL BROKER (8), who was a big trial winner at Bacchus Marsh, and PASTOR CASH (9), who was sound when second on debut. Monitor the markets for first-starter MISTER FUNDADA (4), who trialled really nicely with a come-from-behind win at Maryborough latest. SELECTIONS: VERBICI (5), KYVALLEY DIABLO (1), REGAL GALA (7), KEAYANG MARCUS (3)

OVERVIEW: Like Verbici in race nine, PHOENIX REX (5) is one of the big guns in the two-year-old trotting series for the boys and looks awfully hard to hold out in heat two. He heads here after a short, sharp Queensland campaign where he snared Group 2 success with a simply ridiculous win in the QBRED Final. He made two breaks in that race and lost a huge amount of ground, but still managed to get up and win. He’s five from five to start his career and he’s a very good horse. I’ve got a bit of time for INSULATOR (1), who did things wrong first-up from a break but ran well for a close-up third to Verbici last time out. He draws well and is a key danger to the favourite. CLOUDY CANYON (4) led, ended up three fence and rattled late to be beaten 1.7m by Kyvalley Dixon last time out, ORLANDO VEYRON (8) made a mistake first-up from a break but showed good ability in his first campaign, while SUMTHIN DIFFERENT (7) heads here after a third to Verbici in the Group 2 NSW Trot Final and is a key runner despite the wide gate. SELECTIONS: PHOENIX REX (5), INSULATOR (1), CLOUDY CANYON (4), ORLANDO VEYRON (8) 10-UNIT GAME PLAN R1 #2 KYVALLEY DRIFTER – 2 units (win) R3 #6 HALLEBESOFINE – 2 units (win) R4 #2 GLADIATRIX – 3 units (win) R7 #2 MISTER DEVEREAUX – 3 units (place) EARLY QUADDIE 1,5,8,9/1,2,8/6,7,9/1,2 QUADDIE 2,3/1,2,4/1/3 Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

BUDDY PERFECT (2) sat without cover last time out at Albion Park outside of Bite The Ear Mike and battled on reasonably there for eighth. He draws well in this race and loves to race on the pegs. He can lead and should be hard to run down. ULTIMATE BIRD (6) trialled up well recently at Albion Park when leading and dominating a recent trial over higher assessed Manila Playboy. He may be shuffled back from the wide draw and if the race is run to suit he should be running on late. GREAT ACHIEVER (3) was a good winner at this track three starts ago securing a good run off the speed and running over the top late He can secure a similar type of run in this race and should be running on again. ALTA SENSATION (4) was a terrific winner recently at this track copping plenty of pressure leading before kicking nicely to beat Dolly Rocket. He draws a touch awkwardly this time and may need to do some work at some stage. SELECTIONS: BUDDY PERFECT (2), ULTIMATE BIRD (6), GREAT ACHIEVER (3), ALTA SENSATION (4) SUGGESTED BET: BUDDY PERFECT (2) to win.

MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (3) was forced to do the work outside the leader last time out and wasn’t beat far in fourth behind Jeffcoate. He is likely to get a good run from a good front row draw and can figure in the finish again. ROCK HAMMER (9) ran on strongly last time out into third behind Jeffcoate and Maywyn Troubadour at Albion Park. He is likely to be suited doing no work in a race which could generate a strong tempo early. ROLL TO THE TOP (2) seems to be best suited in races when sat up and saved for one run which should see her suited from a good draw in this race. She got back in the run last time out and couldn’t get into the race which became a dash home and was taken out by Mach Asassin. GRIGORA (1) has gate speed and should get a good run from the favourable draw. He got back last time out and was held up for clear running at a crucial stage in a race taken out by Francs For Coming. SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (3), ROCK HAMMER (9), ROLL TO THE TOP (2), GRIGORA (1) SUGGESTED BET: MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (3) to win.

FOXFIRE EASTON (9) faces a big 30 metre handicap in this race which does look tough on paper but he appears to have a class edge on his rivals. He was a good winner two starts ago running over the top to beat Denver Colorado at this track. THE CASUAL GOOSE (1) has a good record from the stand start and was able to win a heat of this series last year when leading all the way. If he can step to the lead he should give them something to catch again. ROLLING BONUS (8) was held up at a crucial stage last time out before hitting the line nicely to get into the placings behind Lulu Lucifer at this track. He faces a 20 metres handicap in this race but should still run well in this race. MISS HATTIE (2) was running on late last time out into seventh in a race taken out by Oyster Stride. She should settle close in this race and appears well handicapped. SELECTIONS: FOXFIRE EASTON (9), THE CASUAL GOOSE (1), ROLLING BONUS (8), MISS HATTIE (2) SUGGESTED BET: THE CASUAL GOOSE (1) to win.

TERRAGONG SWINGER (4) has working into some good form in recent outings. He ran well last time out when securing a good run and finishing it off well into second behind Francs For Coming. He should settle close and can be running on late. PLANET DOWNS (7) led last time out over the 2138 at Albion Park and was run down late by Monopollie. He draws awkwardly inside the back row this time but with luck in running looks one of the better hopes in this race. THE TIGER ARMY (6) appears to be well graded in this race but does face a poor draw. Sat without cover last time out and battled on nicely there for fourth behind Francs For Coming. He may be left to do the work but should be suited in this field. MAYWYNS ACE (2) was shuffled back last time out and couldn’t get into the race there which was taken out by Monopollie. He should settle closer this time and comes into this race third up from a spell. SELECTIONS: TERRAGONG SWINGER (4), PLANET DOWNS (7), THE TIGER ARMY (6), MAYWYNS ACE (2) SUGGESTED BET: TERRAGONG SWINGER (4) to win.

GETAGRIP (10) took on a much stronger race than this one last time out and wasn’t beaten far in ninth behind Borella. He is likely to appreciate the drop back in grade but does face a 30 metre handicap which could make things tricky for him. BONNIES CAM (8) got back in the run last time out and was making up some late ground in a race taken out by Jeffcoate. He comes into this race fourth up from a spell and should be nearing peak fitness. He is also likely to appreciate the slight handicap advantage on some of his key rivals in this race. THE HARRIS HAWK (9) got back in the run last time out and was making up late ground behind Favreau who rated good time for the grade there. He has a 20 metre handicap to overcome in this race but should be running on late. SPORTY AZZ (7) secured a good run on the pegs last time out and was running on late into fourth behind just 1.6 metres by the winner Oyster Stride. He appears well handicapped in this race and should run well again. SELECTIONS: GETAGRIP (4), BONNIES CAM (8), THE HARRIS HAWK (9), SPORTY AZZ (7) SUGGESTED BET: GETAGRIP (4) to win.

FLYING DRAGON (6) trialled up really nicely when first landing in QLD winning by a big margin there before having time off and returning with another good trial running second to Stormtide which looks good form for a race of this nature. He should be hard to beat. WICKED BERRIES (8) took on a stronger race last time out at Albion Park when finishing seventh behind Eternal Bliss. She should get a good run through in this race and can settle close enough in the urn. She should be running on late. PERFECT LOU (10) led last time out and was just run down late by Maywyn Valentino who has been good in recent outings. He draws less favourably in this race but soes appear to find a race with a touch less depth. MIGHTY IDEAL (5) ran a good second three starts ago behind Number One Ranger at Albion Park. He draws awkwardly in this race and may need luck at some stage to get into the race. SELECTIONS: FLYING DRAGON (6), WICKED BERRIES (8), PERFECT LOU (10), MIGHTY IDEAL (5) SUGGESTED BET: FLYING DRAGON (6) to win.

HES ALL TORQUE (9) secured a good run behind Greatgreat Boulder last time out and was able to sprint well to pick him up late and score rating fast time. He faces a big handicap of 40 metres in this race but does seemingly find what looks to be the weakest heat of this series. ROSIES BOY (8) got a long way back last time out at Albion park and was running on well late there into seventh behind Racana. He looks reasonably well handicapped off 20 metres in this race and should run well. THREE CHORD RIFF (5) secured a good run last time out and was running on well late into second behind Jay Tee Tyron. She stepped away well enough in her standing start prior at Albion Park and should run well off the front in this race. ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (2) appears well handicapped in this race starting off the front. He ran well last time out closing off strongly late when finishing second to Ideal Tiger. SELECTIONS: HES ALL TORQUE (9), ROSIES BOY (8), THREE CHORD RIFF (5), ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (2) SUGGESTED BET: HES ALL TORQUE (9) to win.

CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (1) should have the speed to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. He was running on well last time out at this track into fourth behind La bomba who was able to lead all the way there. MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (9) was left without cover last time out and battled on strongly late for a close up third. She should be able to work around to race up on speed again and should thereabouts again. JILLIBY PANDA (7) seems to be best suited when driven quietly early with a helmet to follow which could see him well suited in this race drawn the inside of the back row. He loomed up strongly last time out but just couldn’t quite finish it off when running fifth behind Three Machs. PLAYFUL MISS (3) secured a good run on the pegs last time out and was running on well late behind Oyster Stride. She should get a good run close to the speed in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (1), MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (9), JILLIBY PANDA (7), PLAYFUL MISS (3) SUGGESTED BET: JILLIBY PANDA (7) each way.

OUR SWEET JESS (9) will start this race off a 30 metre handicap and will need to begin safely to give herself every chance. She has been taking on strongly company including last start when not beaten far by Pretty Little Liar finishing sixth. HES REGAL (7) appeared very unlucky last start when being badly held up for a clear run late last start in a race taken out by Francs For Coming. If he can begin well and settle close in the run he should be thereabouts in this race. ROCKTIME (8) got back last start and was running on late in a race taken out by Shes In Line in good time for the grade. He looks one of the class runners in this race and can look to overcome the 20 metre handicap. GHOST TRAIN (4) comes into this race first up from a spell which does appear a significant query. He was able to take out a heat of this series last year when leading and winning off the front handicap. SELECTIONS: OUR SWEET JESS (9), HES REGAL (7), ROCKTIME (8), GHOST TRAIN (4) SUGGESTED BET: OUR SWEET JESS (9) to win.

DANCINWITHPLEASURE (2) ran on nicely last time out into fourth behind Aragorn. He has good gate speed and may be able to work to the front in this race and should be hard to beat from there. CAPTAINS RUN (8) secured a good run last time out and was running on well into second behind Aesthete. He should get a good run through early in this race and can be running on late. SAUV BLANC (9) was forced to do the work last time out when finishing third behind Cobbity Cadence and Divine Abundance. She should get a good run through in this race and should be running on late in this race. ADORE CINDY (1) was able to secure a good run on the pegs last time out and ran into third there behind Tactique at this track. She should secure a good run again and is likely to have derived benefit from her latest two outings. SELECTIONS: DANCINWITHPLEASURE (2), CAPTAINS RUN (8), SAUV BLANC (9), ADORE CINDY (1) SUGGESTED BET: DANCINWITHPLEASURE (2) to win. SERGENTMAJOR JUJON (1) led last race start before having an issue when beaten a long way. He trialled up smartly recently at this track rating good time leading all the way. He should lead and be hard to beat in this field. FORGETTABLE (3) is having his first run for the stable of Trent Dawson having done a few things wrong while racing in NSW. He got back from a wide draw last time out and couldn’t get into it there in a race which became a dash home. ARKANSAURUS (4) trialled up well in a recent trial when finishing second behind Head Rush. She should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running into it late. COLT KELLY (2) trialled up reasonably well for a race of this nature finishing second behind Rocky Outlook at this track. He draws well in this race and should be close enough in the run. SELECTIONS: SERGENTMAJOR JUJON (1), FORGETTABLE (3), ARKANSAURUS (4), COLT KELLY (2) SUGGESTED BET: SERGENTMAJOR JUJON (1) to win.

USUAL SUSPECT (6) remained unbeaten in QLD last time out when finding the front early before taking them all the way at this track rating good time. He draws wide in this race but may be able to press forward again and find a prominent position which should see him hard to beat. CALL KELLY (5) was just fair when first up from a return at Albion Park fading late into sixth. She put in a much better run last time out when finishing fifth behind Eternal Bliss at Albion Park over the 2138. She is likely to have derived benefit from that run and should run well third up. LITTLE WHIPPET (1) draws well in this race and should settle close enough in the run. He may look to hold a position before handing over to one of the more favoured runners in the race. MACKMLEMORE CHEX (8) led last time out and was just run down late by Son Of Xena who was able to overpower him late and draw away. He should get a good run through early in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: USUAL SUSPECT (6), CALL KELLY (5), LITTLE WHIPPET (1), MACKLEMORE CHEX (8) SUGGESTED BET: USUAL SUSPECT (6) to win.

DEEP REGRET (9) was forced to do plenty of work last time out when sitting outside of Kingsbury and was very good there to battle on for second in a truly run race. He should be able to work into the race at some stage and should be hard to beat in what looks an easier race. ITS ONE LIFE (5) got back in the run last time out and couldn’t get into it in a much stronger race taken out by Barracuda at Albion Park. He looks likely to appreciate the big drop in grade into this race and should be in the finish with the right run. PLAYING FOR KEEPS (3) appeared very unlucky last time out when being forced to make a wide run when they sprinted up a long way from home. She draws better than a lot of her main rivals in this race and may look to hold that advantage early before having options from there if she was able to find the pegs. SAYCHELLES (8) should get a good run off the speed in this race. She got back last time out and couldn’t get into the race there but does reunite with Alanah Richardson who has driven her previously and run well. SELECTIONS: DEEP REGRET (9), ITS ONE LIFE (5), PLAYING FOR KEEPS (3), SAYCHELLES (8) SUGGESTED BET: DEEP REGRET (9) to win.

FAVREAU (2) showed good gate speed to find the front last time out and scored a dominant win there rating good time. He has always seemingly been a horse which liked the 2040 and with a similar effort to last start he should be hard to beat again. LITTLE SURFER GIRL (1) has the draw and likely has the speed to dictate early. She took on a stronger race and was well beaten there behind Barracuda when finishing seventh. LOCHINVAR JEWELLS (7) appears to draw a touch awkwardly insisde the back row but could be suited in this race doing no work early. She looked to be quite unlucky last time out when badly held up for clear running at a crucial stage in a race taken out by Princess Arna. MY ULTIMATE COSSIE (4) secured a good run on the pegs last time out and wasn’t beaten too far by Borella at Albion Park. He looks suited in this race over the 2040 at Redcliffe. SELECTIONS: FAVREAU (2), LITTLE SURFER GIRL (1), LOCHINVAR JEWELLS (7), MY ULTIMATE COSSIE (4) SUGGESTED BET: FAVREAU (2) to win.

ONE CHAIN ROAD (1) has excellent early speed and should be able to hold the lead in the early stages of this race. He got a long way back last time out at Albion Park and was finishing strongly into fourth behind Kingsbury who rated fast time for the grade. WAR CLUB (7) seems to be best suited at this stage of his career when sat up and saved for one run which should see him suited from this draw. He impressed recently at this track when getting back and running over the top to score. ITS BACK PAGE NEWS (9) draws to do no work early in this race which could suit her. She was able to find the front three starts ago at this track and took them all the way there. ROCK IT BABY (6) ran a good second last time out when getting back and finishing it off well behind Prince Joy. He draws poorly outside the front row but is capable of doing work in his races and still fighting out the finish. SELECTIONS: ONE CHAIN ROAD (1), WAR CLUB (7), ITS BACK PAGE NEWS (9), ROCK IT BABY (6) SUGGESTED BET: ONE CHAIN ROAD (1) to win.

OCTOBER RACKETEER (8) burned hard to lead last time out at Albion Park and was just run down late by Llanfair Llewellan who had a softer run off the speed. He finds a race where he won’t be forced to work early and should be hard to beat with the right run. BURNS BAY (5) got a long way back last time out at Albion Park and ran on strongly there to finish second behind Racana. He appears to find a similar type of race which may generate good early tempo. He should be running on again. AQUA CRUISER (3) was a good winner two starts ago when working into the clear to beat Vodka En Ice at this track. He should be able to work into a prominent position early in this race and should run well again. JAY TEE TYRON (4) was able to show good early speed at Albion Park recently finding the front and taking them all the way to record a nice win. He had a less favourable run last time out when finishing fifth having sat outside of Favreau. SELECTIONS: OCTOBER RACKETEER (8), BURNS BAY (5), AQUA CRUISER (3), JAY TEE TYRON (4) SUGGESTED BET: OCTOBER RACKETEER (8) to win.

MAGIC JUJON (9) should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on strongly late. She has progressed nicely since joining the stable of Donny Smith and may have put in her best run yet last time out when finishing strongly into second behind Bite The Ear Mike. STILLYOURSHOT (4) should have the speed to drive through and work to the lead in the early stages of this race from a good draw. He ran well two starts ago when finishing second to Rock Nien after sitting on the leaders back in that race. MAHINDI (6) has been in terrific form and will be looking for a hat-trick of wins in this race. She looks to draw awkwardly in this race outside the front row which could see her shuffled back to last or forced to do a lot of work. MISS SYRAH (7) appears to draw quite awkwardly inside the back row in this race and will need luck at the right time to get into the clear. She does have a nice turn of speed and in a race which appears likely to produce a genuine tempo she can be running on late. SELECTIONS: MAGIC JUJON (9), STILLYOURSHOT (4), MAHINDI (6), MISS SYRAH (7) SUGGESTED BET: MAGIC JUJON (9) to win.

IM BUSTED (1) should have the speed to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from a good draw. He secured a good run last time out and was running on nicely into second behind Docta Feelgood in a race the winner rated good time. TORO LOCO (7) should get a good run through in the early stages behind the likely lead of the race IM BUSTED (1). He secured a good run on the pegs last time out and appeared a touch unlucky finishing fifth behind Princess Arna at Albion Park. BOSTON CHIEF (6) doesn’t have very impressive numerical form but has seemingly turned a corner recently and is beginning to work into some better form. He ran well to finish sixth behind Pure Grunt on went on to take the final of the QBRED Triad series. OUR ULTIMATE MILLY (3) trialled up reasonably for a race of this nature. She draws well on the front row and should settle close enough in the run. SELECTIONS: IM BUSTED (1), TORO LOCO (7), BOSTON CHIEF (6), OUR ULTIMATE MILLY (3) SUGGESTED BET: IM BUSTED (1) to win.
